title: Crystal Clear Bar Salts Juicy Grape Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Crystal Clear Juicy Grape Nic Salt delivers a full-bodied Grape flavour that is sweet and aromatic with every puff. The profile captures the rich taste of sun-ripened Grapes and stays consistent from inhale to exhale, making it a dependable all-day vape for fruit lovers. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nic Salt e-liquid is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with pod kits and vape pens. Choose from 10mg or 20mg strengths for fast-acting nicotine absorption and a smooth throat hit. Crystal Clear Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same great-tasting flavours that made disposable vapes so popular, now reimagined for refillable pod kits. Designed for clarity, consistency and convenience, this UK-made range focuses on fruity, icy, and confectionery-inspired blends that cater to everyday vapers.
